plan.title: Liver treated vs control DE with n=3/group + GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: The data context specifies 12,000 gene-level raw Salmon counts across 6 human liver samples (3 treated, 3 control), unpaired, single batch. The knowledge service (grounded, snapshot sha256:dfcde5f7e64089dd43007623dd938eeca4962364bac2e2ee6cb83880a7422101) recommends: (1) sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap) before any modeling to catch outliers/batch structure; (2) a minimal count pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, the smallest group size) followed by DESeq2's own independent filtering rather than an aggressive upfront filter; (3) DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization built into the model (no separate normalization step); (4) an explicit reference-level assignment (control) and Wald-test DE with apeglm shrinkage as the primary test, cross-checked with edgeR quasi-likelihood as a second method because n=3/group gives materially lower detection power and the two-method overlap is the more defensible 'high-confidence' set (R-0001, R-0042); (5) BH-adjusted FDR at alpha=0.05 with independent filtering, p-value histogram inspected before trusting the adjustment; (6) preranked fgsea GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic against the full tested-gene list, using the locally staged MSigDB Hallmark human collection as the primary set and Reactome/WikiPathways as follow-up, because a discrete significant-gene list at n=3 is likely to be short and underpowered for over-representation testing (R-0103 flags ORA as unreliable below ~50 significant genes) — GSEA on the full ranked list is the grounded default for exactly this situation; (7) a final report step that explicitly states the expected statistical power at n=3/group (R-0094, R-0017), the overlap between DESeq2 and edgeR, fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), and full reproducibility metadata. The knowledge_check tool rejected a GO-ORA-first ordering for this ranked-list situation and confirmed fgsea-on-stat-with-Hallmark is the grounded enrichment method when enrichment_input=ranked_list is declared, so that ordering is kept. All reference data cited (MSigDB Hallmark human 2026.1, Reactome current, WikiPathways human 2026.07.10) is confirmed present in the environment.
